gloss: slit; incision; notch cut into something

definitions.explanation: A cut made partway into a material or a piece of food, leaving it in one piece. Used for packaging that tears open easily, for scoring bread or fish before cooking, and for notches in paper or cloth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切|き}り{込|こ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Cut a slit in the bag.

examples.japanese: ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧{切|き}り{込|こ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: Make a shallow slit in the bread before baking it.
If you score the skin of the fish beforehand, it cooks through more easily.

notes:
The noun of {切|き}り{込|こ}む (to cut into). Nearly always appears with ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ — the slit is "put into" the object.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|き}り{込|こ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to make a slit
- ⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧/⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{切|き}り{込|こ}み: a shallow / deep incision
- {切|き}り{込|こ}み⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧: a cut line, tear line on packaging

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{切|き}れ{目|め}→切れ目：20720_kireme⟧: a break or gap — the resulting opening, not the act of cutting
- {刻|きざ}み: chopping into small pieces — cutting all the way through, repeatedly
